title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：venue　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 venue 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the athlete ① chose the venue that no trainer in the stadium would have measured, and he said the choosing was the whole of the year. The ② venue, meaning the place itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a venue, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ venue in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ venue at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A venue, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the athlete said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the venue was the whole of the matter, meaning the occasion and not the place. The ⑥ venue, meaning the occasion and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; venue, he said, is either something you choose or the only word that means both a place and an occasion. He said the occasion is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ venue had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ venue of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of measuring; venue, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ venue I remember is the place measured in the programme, which closed in 1982 and is still measured as the quietest in the stadium. A ⑩ venue, my mother said in 1984, is the only place that improves by being measured; every venue, she said, is an occasion that has agreed to look like a place. She said the occasion was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 场所；会场（指体育场里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 场所；会场（指那处场所本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：choose the venue 选定这一处场所
D. n. 场所；会场（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 场所之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的场所之事）
F. n. 场所；会场（指秩序册里写到、被测量的那一处）
G. n. 场所、场合（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 场合（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: chose the venue that no trainer in the stadium would have measured
The venue, meaning the place itself and not the bib
the venue at the far track
the venue was the whole of the matter
the venue had become a line in a programme
The venue of the whole thing
A venue, my mother said in 1984

answers.why: choose the venue 意为“选定这一处场所”，1975 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯测量的一处场所做了一遍。
venue 意为“场所；会场”，指那处场所本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被测量。
venue 意为“场所；会场”，指体育场里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
venue 意为“场所；会场”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
venue 意为“场所、场合”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这处场合就是那件事的全部。
venue 意为“场合”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处场所，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
venue 意为“场所；会场”，指秩序册里写到、被测量的那一处，到 1980 年这一处成了秩序册里的一行。
venue 意为“场所之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的场所之事是一处体育场和三个年份的测量。
venue 意为“场所；会场”，我记得的是秩序册里测量过的那一处，1982 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一处。
venue 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，场所是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的场所。
